contract.document_name.value: COOPERATION AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF FORT STOCKTON, TEXAS AND STW RESOURCES HOLDING CORP. REGARDING DEVELOPMENT OF WATER WELL(S) IN THE CAPITAN REEF AQUIFER FORMATION
contract.document_name.rationale: The heading titles the document as a Cooperation Agreement between COFS and STW regarding water wells in the Capitan Reef Aquifer Formation.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Signature dates are blank; the notarial acknowledgments give only the year "day of , 2014".

contract.effective_date.rationale: The effective date is defined as the last date of signature, but no signature date is filled in.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is thirty years from the Effective Date; no calendar expiration date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 18 states the agreement is controlled by the laws of the State of Texas.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 3 provides the agreement automatically renews from year-to-year after the 30-year term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Renewal can be prevented by a Party upon sixty (60) days' written notice (Section 3).
